profile: G7 SBOM for AI - Minimum Elements

source.page_numbering: Printed page numbers; PDF page index is printed page + 1 (zero-based).
source.verification: Element names, cluster membership and definitions checked against sections 2.1-2.7 of the downloaded BSI publication.

scoring: Project-defined known-evidence coverage: present / 50. Partial, review and explicit unknown do not earn full credit. Not a G7-prescribed score or proof of compliance.

elements.name: SBOM author
elements.notes: The operator creating the BOM, not the generation tool or component manufacturer.

elements.name: SBOM version
elements.notes: CycloneDX revision number; schema validation enforces a positive integer.

elements.name: SBOM data format name
elements.notes: Must equal CycloneDX; checked before assessment.

elements.name: SBOM data format version
elements.notes: Only CycloneDX 1.7 is assessed by this mapping.

elements.name: SBOM author signature
elements.notes: Signature structure does not establish author attribution, cryptographic validity, or algorithm approval. Verify separately.

elements.name: SBOM tool name
elements.notes: Every declared generation tool must have a name; deprecated metadata.tools[] is also supported.

elements.name: SBOM tool version
elements.notes: Every declared generation tool must have a version. Explicit unknowns remain visible.

elements.name: SBOM generation context
elements.notes: Lifecycle phase conveys generation context; no custom namespace is required.

elements.name: SBOM timestamp
elements.notes: Document update time, distinct from system/model update time.

elements.name: SBOM dependency relationship
elements.notes: Resolved edges provide inclusion evidence. Derivation and graph completeness need review.

elements.name: System name
elements.notes: Only an application BOM subject connected to a typed model is selected as a system.

elements.name: System components
elements.notes: The system's resolved outgoing dependency edges are candidates; inventory completeness needs review.

elements.name: System producer
elements.notes: A supplier need not be the producer; supplier is not accepted automatically.

elements.name: System version
elements.notes: Unknown is explicitly reported, without known-value credit.

elements.name: System timestamp
elements.notes: Release-note creation time is only a candidate for the system's most recent update; metadata.timestamp is not evidence.

elements.name: System data flow
elements.notes: Review component-to-component flow; a data classification or generic service entry alone is insufficient.

elements.name: System data usage
elements.notes: Review how data is consumed and processed; classification is not a usage description.

elements.name: System input/output properties
elements.notes: A model's input/output formats do not establish the surrounding system's input/output properties.

elements.name: Intended application area
elements.notes: Review deployment context; arbitrary descriptions/tags do not establish intended application area.

elements.name: Model name
elements.notes: Check each typed machine-learning-model, including nested and metadata components.

elements.name: Model identifier
elements.notes: A bom-ref is local to this BOM; it does not establish external identity or resolvability.

elements.name: Model version
elements.notes: Every model is checked independently; explicit unknown receives no known-value credit.

elements.name: Model timestamp
elements.notes: Release-note creation is a candidate, not proof of model update/release time.

elements.name: Model producer
elements.notes: Producer means originator/manufacturer; a distributor's supplier field is insufficient.

elements.name: Model description
elements.notes: Capabilities, limitations and lineage require semantic review. All three groups are candidates, not proof of completeness.

elements.name: Model hash value
elements.notes: Schema-valid digest is documented; artifact binding and recomputation are not performed.

elements.name: Model hash algorithm
elements.notes: CycloneDX uses its own algorithm labels. IANA name alignment and relevant-authority approval require review.

elements.name: Model properties
elements.notes: Records explicit architecture characteristics; an empty model card or input formats alone are insufficient.

elements.name: Model input-output properties
elements.notes: Both directions must be documented on every model.

elements.name: Model training properties
elements.notes: Learning approach is partial evidence; training/fine-tuning methods and stages need review. Task/architecture/inputs alone do not qualify.

elements.name: Model license
elements.notes: Assesses documented license type only. G7 lists openness of weights/architecture/data/training as illustrative examples, not a separate mandatory checklist. This profile does not infer openness.

elements.name: Model external references
elements.notes: Presence of a reference does not verify remote content; no URLs are fetched.

elements.name: Dataset name
elements.notes: Typed dataset components and inline datasets are assessed; referenced targets are resolved.

elements.name: Dataset description
elements.notes: A description is candidate evidence for intended use (training, fine tuning, evaluation); semantic review remains.

elements.name: Dataset content
elements.notes: Content links/attachments are candidates. Review content description, modality and encoding; retrieval is not performed.

elements.name: Dataset identifier
elements.notes: Unresolved model-card dataset references remain review items and do not receive identity credit.

elements.name: Dataset hash
elements.notes: Digest belongs to the dataset component, never to an unrelated model or library. Inline data has no native hashes field.

elements.name: Dataset provenance
elements.notes: Governance/ancestry provide candidates. Collection, curation, labeling and synthetic-data methods need review.

elements.name: Dataset statistical properties
elements.notes: No automatic semantics for arbitrary properties; inspect lifecycle statistics such as mean/variance.

elements.name: Dataset sensitivity
elements.notes: Review PII, copyright, confidentiality and other sensitivity categories; absence cannot establish no sensitive data.

elements.name: Dataset dependency relationship
elements.notes: G7 describes creation/maintenance software and derivation from other datasets. A model-to-dataset link alone is insufficient.

elements.name: Dataset license
elements.notes: Only the dataset's own license is credited. Inline data cannot borrow the model's license.

elements.name: Infrastructure software
elements.notes: Resolved model/application-to-software edges are candidates for runtime infrastructure. Dataset edges alone are insufficient.

elements.name: Infrastructure hardware
elements.notes: Verify that a BOM reference is an HBOM for deployment hardware; generic BOM links/hardware entries do not prove this.

elements.name: Security controls
elements.notes: Review implemented AI-specific and general security controls and their scope.

elements.name: Security compliance
elements.notes: Review certification applicability, issuer, evidence and validity; arbitrary properties cannot certify compliance.

elements.name: Cybersecurity policy information
elements.notes: Only security.txt URL candidates qualify. Producer attribution and retrieved content require review.

elements.name: Vulnerability referencing
elements.notes: G7 asks for exploitability databases/repositories. Generic vulnerability presence or an empty vulnerability list is insufficient.

elements.name: Security metrics
elements.notes: Review security-specific benchmarks (e.g. adversarial robustness); generic accuracy is insufficient.

elements.name: Operational performance KPIs
elements.cyclonedx: operational metrics documentation or scoped properties
elements.notes: G7 examples concern uptime, incident resolution, latency, throughput and load balancing. Model accuracy does not qualify.
